name: Exage 300LX normal-band front derailleur (1990 reference)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 135 g for FD-M300 in its explicitly identified 28.0–28.6 mm normal-band configuration. The EC-type and later -B references remain separate; another clamp size or suffix equivalence is not inferred.
